versions.changelog:
- Added a CLI entry point (`scripts/cli.mjs`) for invoking all query commands via a unified interface.
- Introduced a reference guide (`references/cli.md`) detailing subcommand usage and examples.
- Updated the skill description and documentation to emphasize four API commands (search, meta, dynamic, kline) and how to use them with the CLI.
- Expanded and clarified usage instructions, supported chain list, and API rules.
- Removed deprecated documentation file (`skill-card.md`).

binance-web3 v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Query Token Info skill by binance-web3-team.
- Enables searching for tokens by name, symbol, or contract address across BSC, Base, and Solana chains.
- Provides APIs to retrieve token metadata (details, social links, creator, description).
- Offers real-time market data: price, price trend, volume, holders, liquidity, and market cap.
- Supports fetching K-Line candlestick (OHLCV) charts for technical analysis.
